history.summary: Shrikshetra Dham, the Sri Sri Jagannath Temple at Khanikar Gaon, Dibrugarh, was completed in 2014 as an 85-ft Kalinga-architecture replica of the Puri Jagannath Temple (the 'second form' of the original). Five bighas of land were donated by the Bakpara Tea Estate; construction was supervised by the Sri Sri Jagannath Cultural Trust, its guardian and custodian, and the temple was built by then-Assam Governor Janaki Ballabh Patnaik. The 2014 Prana Prastha Samaroh was held in the presence of priests from the Tirupati Balaji Temple. The complex has 7 temples and sits near Mahatma Gandhi Park on the Dibrugarh-Tinsukia bypass road.

town_description: Dibrugarh is Upper Assam's 'Tea City', the headquarters of Dibrugarh district on the south bank of the Brahmaputra, about 50 km southwest of Tinsukia. It hosts Assam Medical College and Dibrugarh University, and the Bogibeel rail-cum-road bridge; it is a gateway to Arunachal Pradesh.
